# openmetadata_spreadsheet (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata spreadsheet. Spreadsheets are the files that live inside a drive service, optionally grouped in a directory.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_drive_service" "reports" {
  name         = "google-drive"
  service_type = "GoogleDrive"
}

resource "openmetadata_directory" "quarterly" {
  name    = "reports"
  service = openmetadata_drive_service.reports.fully_qualified_name
}

resource "openmetadata_spreadsheet" "revenue" {
  name         = "quarterly-revenue"
  service      = openmetadata_drive_service.reports.fully_qualified_name
  parent       = openmetadata_directory.quarterly.fully_qualified_name
  display_name = "Quarterly revenue"
  description  = "Revenue workbook refreshed every quarter."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Spreadsheet name. Changing it replaces the spreadsheet, because the name is part of its fully qualified name.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent drive service. Changing it replaces the spreadsheet.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Markdown description of the spreadsheet.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown in the OpenMetadata UI.
- `parent` (String) Fully qualified name of the directory that contains the spreadsheet. Changing it replaces the spreadsheet.

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name, in the form service.spreadsheet or service.directory.spreadsheet.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import openmetadata_spreadsheet.revenue 1f6a3a52-8d34-4f4b-9d0f-2f1c1c1c1c1c

# Or import by fully qualified name, in the form service.directory.spreadsheet.
terraform import openmetadata_spreadsheet.revenue google-drive.reports.quarterly-revenue
```
